name: Truck Simulator: Heavy Cargo Offroad
summary: Drive a powerful cargo truck in Truck Simulator: Heavy Cargo Offroad, a realistic Truck Simulator built for offroad cargo delivery. Take your cargo truck across jungle, snow, desert, & mountain tracks while handling heavy cargo, long trailers, steep climbs, narrow roads, & rough terrain. Enjoy immersive truck driving with smooth controls, realistic truck driving physics, Offroad Truck Simulator challenges, Cargo Truck Simulator missions, & heavy-duty truck routes made for skilled truck drivers
